scope: This guide covers surface cleaning and follow-up inspection after freshwater splash, wet grass or mud on an electric model that permits such use. The examples are the Traxxas TRX-4 Sport 82224-4 and blue ARRMA Mojave 6S V3 ARA7604V3T1. Submersion, contaminated water, erratic electronics and suspected battery water ingress call for the manufacturer’s support before power is restored.
archiveIntent: Follow-up care after permitted freshwater exposure. The general inspection checklist covers dry use, and the grass guide addresses terrain choice and pre-run restrictions.

findings.verified: Wet running excludes LiPo, transmitter moisture and salt or contaminated water. The exact procedure includes battery removal, gentle cleaning, targeted corrosion protection, cover removal and seal care. Extended wet use brings separate portal, transmission and motor procedures.

findings.locator: Manufacturer manual p. 3, Wet Conditions Maintenance, and the exact blue package listing
findings.verified: Manual distinguishes electronics protection from whole-vehicle limits and requires distinct wet care for exposed metal, bearings, transmission and differentials. The MOTOR is excluded from the exposed-metal water-displacing-oil step.
Context on the Sport format only. The exact 82224-4 manual provides every operation and maintenance limit used here.
